accessMethod: Pinned HTTPS release-tag download; the repository ships a selected JSON excerpt.
attribution: Contains data from OpenNGC, copyright OpenNGC contributors, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
updateStrategy: Create a new immutable raw version directory, review upstream field/source changes, update the checksum, and rerun the pipeline. Never mutate a published raw version.
coordinateSystem: Equatorial J2000 in source sexagesimal notation; normalised sample uses operational ICRS degrees at Julian epoch 2000.0 with a frame-precision caveat.
uncertaintyFields: No uncertainty values are present in the selected OpenNGC columns; derived records explicitly omit uncertainty.
transformations: Select four named records without changing source values.
Parse sexagesimal right ascension and declination into degrees.
Map OpenNGC type codes to Atlas object types while preserving the original typeCode.
Expand the selected IAU constellation abbreviations to conventional names.
Preserve observed V magnitude and heliocentric redshift without deriving distance.
validationRules: Reject malformed sexagesimal coordinates and non-finite values.
Require complete source provenance and an explicit dataOrigin of catalogue.
Require right ascension in [0, 360) deg and declination in [-90, +90] deg.
knownLimitations: Four records are not representative of the full catalogue.
Magnitude and coordinate uncertainties are unavailable in this excerpt.
The operational ICRS mapping is limited by the source's J2000 frame description and is not a claim of milliarcsecond accuracy.
Redshift is not converted into cosmological distance.
